name: EZIO8SA
description: An 8-output, 7-input Insteon/X10 controller with Form C relays. It connects to Insteon through a PowerLinc Modem plugged into its PLM port; its inputs are 4 opto-isolated, 2 analog and one 1-Wire input.

verification.note: Insteon Device Categories and Product Keys (October 2008) assigns 0x07/0x04 to the Compacta EZIO8SA I/O Module; the EZIOxx Advanced Details give 0x07/0x02 for EZIO as a whole. The catalog uses 0x07/0x04, the model's own entry.
The EZIOxx Advanced Details cover the whole EZIOxx line, from inputs-only to outputs-only models, and warn that a model may not support every command.
The Quick Start Guide - EZIO8SA links input N by tapping the SET button N times; that input N sends group N is read from that. The EZIOxx Advanced Details let each input's group number be changed.

notes: Neither Quick Start Guide gives a model number; the profile is named for the product.
Outputs 7 and 8 are swapped: to control output 8, address output 7, and the other way around.

It needs an Insteon PowerLinc Modem, dual-band recommended, connected to its PLM port with a straight-through CAT5 patch cable, and a 9 to 18 V DC adapter, center positive. The EZIO8SA & PLM Combo comes with the modem and a 12 V DC adapter. An EZIComm 5010K connected this way doesn't power the EZIO8SA.
Each relay is Form C (SPDT), rated 3 A at 24 V DC or 120 V AC, with CM, NC and NO terminals. Output timers run from 1 to 255 seconds or minutes.

Inputs 1 to 4 (DI1 to DI4) are opto-isolated and need 3 to 30 V DC; a dry contact can use the 12 V DC terminal. Inputs 5 and 6 (Anl1, Anl2) are digital by default, on at 0 to 1 V DC and off at 2 to 3 V DC, or analog for 0 to 3 V DC sensors with trip points from 0 to 1023; ground them if unused, or they send constant Insteon traffic. Input 7 is 1-Wire, for a DS18B20 temperature sensor.

To link an input as a controller: hold the SET button on the modem 10 to 12 seconds and release it (the LED goes out); tap it once per input number, then hold it 3 to 5 seconds (the LED blinks); press the SET button of each responder. Linking mode times out after 4 minutes; holding the SET button 3 to 5 seconds ends it.

To link an output as a responder: put the controller in linking mode, hold the SET button on the EZIO8SA's modem 3 to 5 seconds (the LED goes out), tap it once per output number, then hold it 3 to 5 seconds. Skip the taps to link a snapshot of all the relays as they are. A controller's button can be linked to only one output; a later link from it replaces the earlier one.
X10: relays 1 to 8 answer units 1 to 8 of any house code. To enable X10, hold the SET button on the modem 3 to 5 seconds (the LED blinks) and send an X10 On 3 times; an Off disables it.

Factory reset: unplug the modem for at least 10 seconds, then hold its SET button while plugging it back in, for 3 to 5 seconds, and release it when the buzzer stops. The LED goes out for a second and comes back on when the reset is done.
An EZEye light sensor on an analog input reads 1023 counts at about 3 V.
